text: To prepare the ingredients for cooking, select onions, garlic, and other aromatics, including celery and carrots. Boil these vegetables with water and aromatics to release their natural flavors and textures. The boiling water breaks down the cell walls of the onions, releasing their sweet, pungent aroma. Garlic, with its strong flavor, can be added after the onions have softened. When the vegetables are ready, add them to a pan with olive oil and herbs such as thyme or rosemary. A quick sauté with salt and pepper can enhance the dish. Finally, to cook and bring out the flavors, simmer the vegetables or use a quick sauté to get everything nice and tender.
